cases.name: a Link that appears records from the first Round after its settle
a Gateway change starts another settle; a Round across the change records nothing

description: A Link that appears or changes waits the settle time: its Rounds that touch [change, change + settle) record nothing, as a Pause cuts Rounds (history.md, Link settle). Each Round runs from start to the end of its last Probe; expected lists the at of each Round on that Link that records.
